bugs.name: Synchronous webhook events stay on Checkout after selecting Order
bugs.summary: The synchronous webhook editor keeps Checkout event options visible after Order is selected, preventing the user from seeing the selected category’s event list.
bugs.expected: After Order is highlighted, the Events pane should update to Order’s events or be empty if none are available.
bugs.actual: After selecting Checkout and Calculate taxes, then selecting Order, Order became highlighted but the Events pane still showed Calculate taxes and Filter shipping methods. Checkout retained a selection-count badge. The mismatch remained after waiting six seconds and reselecting Order.
reproSteps: Load the provided authenticated organization-admin session (saved-auth-state flow; no credentials were typed) and open /.
Go to Extensions > Installed > Add Extension > Provide details manually. Create and save a fresh extension named extensions-webhook-category-20261012-1847.

Open that extension and choose Create Webhook. On /extensions/custom/QXBwOjI%3D/webhook, enter webhook name extensions-webhook-category-hook-20261012-1847 and target https://target-extensions-webhook-category-1847.invalid/webhook. Turn the webhook’s Active toggle off and leave it inactive; do not activate it.
Select Synchronous mode, choose Checkout under Objects, and select Calculate taxes under Events.

Choose Order under Objects. Observe that Order is highlighted, while Events still lists Calculate taxes and Filter shipping methods and Checkout retains its selection-count badge; wait six seconds and confirm the mismatch remains.
bugs.reason: Order and Checkout legitimately each expose Calculate taxes and Filter shipping methods. Switching to Order renders unchecked ORDER_* events while retaining the separately selected CHECKOUT_* event and its badge.
